 Order
Present petitioner has field present petition under section 482 of Cr.P.C of extension of time for compliance of the earlier order dated 16/09/2008 passed in CRR no. 209/2006 passed by this Court.

Brief fact of the case is that petitioner/accused has been convicted by the trial Court under section 7(i)(iii) read with section 16(i) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced to undergo six months rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs. 1000/-The
petitioner preferred an appeal before the Sessions Signature NotCourt, Verified but the same was rejected.

Thereafter, the petitioner preferred Criminal Signed by: AMOL N Revision no. 209/2006 before this Court and the same was decided vide order MAHANAG Signing time: 7/14/2022 6:34:48 PM dated 16/09/2008, whereby the conviction of the petitioner was maintained, but the sentenced was modified to the extend that in place of jail sentence, the petitioner shall deposit a sum of Rs. 20,000/- within a period of three Murlidhar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 14 July, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43257870/
1 months as a fine in computation of his jail sentence of six months in addition to fine of Rs. 1000/-.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner contended that the petitioner was remained on bail and he was not aware with the order passed by this Court, therefore, he failed to deposit the fine amount as directed by this Court within the stipulated period, therefore, he prays that the order passed by this Court dated 16/09/2008.
and further four week' time be granted to the petitioner to comply with the said order by depositing the fine amount Rs. 20,000/-.
Learned PL for the respondent/State orally opposed the same and prays for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for both the parties and perused the earlier order passed by this Court.
Considering all the facts and circumstance, it appears that anyhow, the petitioner has failed to comply with the earlier order passed by this Court.

he has not deposited the fine of Rs. 20,000/-
within the stipulated period, but now he he ready to deposit the entire fine amount within a period of four weeks.

Accordingly, present petition filed under section 482 of Cr.P.C by the petitioner is allowed and the order dated 16/09/2008 passed in CRR no. 209/2006 is modified to the extent that the petitioner shall deposit the fine amount of Rs. 20,000/- within a period of four weeks from today.

(ANIL VERMA) JUDGE amol Murlidhar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 14 July, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43257870/
